g.text: WHAT EACH TIMESCALE HAS TO COVER
ITI / PSU ride-through context ≈ 20 ms [Vendor claim]
AI iteration ripple 0.1–2 Hz needs ≲ 10 ms response (CALC-004)
grid → genset gap ≈ 10–15 s, bridged by UPS behind open-transition ATS
AI ramp limit 3 MW/min (A): ≈ 11.4 MW but only 0.46 MWh (CALC-004)
Uptime Tier: ≥ 12 h fuel at N [Verified, Uptime Journal 2014]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: · No single layer covers 1 µs to 24 h. Fast layers have little energy; long layers respond slowly.
· The campus BESS cannot replace the UPS (150 ms response, 20 kV, behind ATS) or the gensets (27 min) — CALC-004 §4.
· AI ripple is a ms-to-s problem: capacitors / supercap, not a 20 kV BESS alone (5.6 MW p-p residual at 150 ms).
· Labels: [Verified] = source opened 2026-10-29; (A) / model values = Project 04 assumptions; [Vendor claim] not a design value.
